version.changelog: MeshMorize v1 merge: full memory compliance system with fresh layer, mesh, auto-log, search, and memcheck

llm.summary: MeshMorize is a disclosed local memory/logging helper, but users should treat its interaction logging as sensitive and configure it carefully.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a multi-layer memory system with daily notes, mesh indexing, interaction logging, search, and compliance checks; those capabilities are coherent with the skill description.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The artifact clearly mentions auto-logging every interaction, but it does not define consent, redaction, retention, or exclusion rules for sensitive conversations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is manual and asks the user to place scripts in workspace folders and symlink them into PATH; the reviewed package only contains SKILL.md, so users should inspect any referenced GitHub scripts before installing them.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The described storage is local memory files and local search/indexing, with no artifact evidence of network exfiltration, credential access, destructive behavior, or hidden background execution.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill creates persistent local memory/log files and suggests session-start initialization, but no automatic privilege escalation, startup registration, or unbounded background worker is present in the reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with local conversation history being recorded and searchable. Before enabling auto-logging, inspect the referenced scripts, decide what should not be logged, avoid recording secrets or regulated data, and periodically delete or rotate stored memory files.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The auto-logging concern is supported by the artifact text and is purpose-aligned for a memory system; it warrants privacy guidance, but the behavior is disclosed and there is no evidence of hidden exfiltration or malicious use.
